notes: Linked as "Statewide Recapitulation Report (PDF)" from the page headed "OFFICIAL 2020 GENERAL ELECTION RESULTS" (https://sos.ms.gov/elections/electionresults_aspx/elections_results_2020_general.aspx), framed by https://www.sos.ms.gov/elections-voting/election-results/2020/2020-general-election. Real text: every contest the State canvasses, county by county, with a TOTAL column; every column was checked to add up to TOTAL before a contest was stored.

Adams County: precinct figures, and the county and local contests on its ballot

Their official record is the county election commission's Official Recapitulation by precinct, which the Secretary of State posts for 2020 only as a scanned PDF (Adams; Adams_Amended).
